data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jiyaz', meaning 'forbidden'. In this context, Jiyaaza signifies 'made gentle', 'gracious', or 'gently treated'. The name Jiyaaza carries the meaning “Gentle, Gracious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jiyaaza usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
